input.executive_summary: On 28 September 2026, a new spending-summary feature was turned on for the online shop's customer account pages. The new code failed whenever it had no spending figures to summarise, so the account page returned an error instead of loading. The fault began at 12:56 UTC and the service was back to normal by 13:02 UTC — about six minutes. During that window roughly three in ten requests failed, against a normal background of about one in a hundred; the worst single minute was close to four in ten. Shoppers trying to view their account page during those minutes would have seen an error and needed to retry; browsing and checkout paths were not implicated. Automated monitoring raised the alert at 13:01, identified the newly enabled feature as the cause, and switched it back off, which returned error rates to their normal level. The feature remains off and a code change to handle the empty case safely has been proposed for review before it is enabled again.
input.root_cause: The feature flag `monthly-spend-feature` was switched from off to on at 12:56, and the code path it enables calls `max()` on an empty iterable at `src/io_shop/monthly_statement.py:626`, so account page requests that hit the new path raised a `ValueError` and returned errors. Reverting the flag to off restored the service to baseline; a draft PR (Argus-Demo-Target-App#73) has been opened to guard the empty case.
